subject: pigeons
one_liner: Save the ledges, crumbs and bronze heads you plan to sit on later.
brand_voice_notes: Pitched like a Series B visual discovery platform that has done extensive user research and drawn the wrong conclusions from all of it. Pins are called perches, boards are called roosts. Everything is measured: crumb density, spike risk, statue occupancy. The bird is always the customer and never once acknowledged as a bird. No puns on coo. No winking.

hero.h1: Every good ledge, saved for later.
hero.sub: Ledge. is the visual discovery board for city pigeons. Pin the windowsills, food-court floors and bronze generals worth coming back to. 41 million perches catalogued across 6 cities, most of them in Rome.

features.title: Crumb-aware discovery
features.blurb: The recommendation engine learns which pastries you peck at and shows you more of them, in the same car park, at 7:40 every morning. In 14 months it has never once recommended a different car park.

features.title: Statue boards
features.blurb: Sort bronze heads by sculptor, era and how much they have already been sat on. The Garibaldi in Piazza Garibaldi has 2.3 million saves and is now, structurally, mostly our users.

features.title: Sit later
features.blurb: Spot a ledge mid-flight and save it with one tap. Ledge. reminds you about it 9 to 14 months later, which our data shows is roughly when the building installs the spikes.

demo_screen_concept: The Ledge. home feed: a Pinterest masonry grid of saved perches (a bronze general's head, a sunny windowsill, a café table under a fallen croissant, a bus shelter roof, a man's shoulder) each with a coral 'Perch' save button, a crumb density readout, a spike risk badge and a save count. Filter chips across the top (All, Ledges, Statues, Crumbs, Shoulders, Spiked) and a fake search box filter the grid live. Clicking Perch opens a 'Save to roost' modal listing boards like 'Ledges I Respect', 'Bread Adjacent' and 'Generals on Horses' with pin counts that increment; clicking a pin opens a detail sheet with a sit-later reminder date.

design_direction.style: Masonry pinboard visual-discovery app, pavement daylight mode. Vibrant & block-based consumer social product: a staggered masonry grid of rounded photo cards on a pale pavement-grey ground, big rounded pill buttons, chunky geometric sans headlines. Explicitly absent, because the last seven entries used them: lip buttons, lesson paths, bone meters, mascots in speech bubbles, wall labels, empty plinths, clay shadow stacks, silk threads, exuvia outlines, LCD greens, parts diagrams, warning boxes, rhumb lines, cartouches, wax seals, acorn marks, dot maps, terminal panels, name tags, punch cards, thermal tickets. Also absent: dark backgrounds, glassmorphism, serif type, paper textures, hard offset shadows. Four motifs carry the page. (1) The masonry pin: every content block (features, testimonials, tiers) is a rounded 20px card of varying height in a staggered column grid, like a feed. (2) The Perch button: a coral pill reading 'Perch' sits on hover over every pin, Pinterest's red save button transplanted to pigeon-foot coral. (3) The neck sheen: a violet-to-green iridescent gradient, the only gradient anywhere, rationed to the hero underline, the highlighted tier's border and the active filter chip. (4) The crumb trail: section dividers are rows of small irregular beige crumbs. Corners 20px on cards, 999px on buttons and chips. Shadows: one soft 0 1px 2px plus 0 8px 24px at 6% only on hover.

fonts.body: 'Work Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

design_direction.archetype: Portfolio grid / visual discovery consumer social: hero with a masonry collage of pins, a feature masonry, testimonial pins, pricing tiers, footer CTA.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Pins rise 12px and fade in staggered 40ms per card on load; on hover a pin lifts 2px and its Perch button fades in; Perch press scales to 0.96 and flips to 'Perched' with a count bump; reduced-motion disables all of it.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Left: chunky Outfit h1 with the neck-sheen underline under 'ledge', sub, coral CTA pill and a search-bar-shaped secondary element reading 'Search 41,000,000 perches'. Right: a 3-column masonry collage of the pin photos at staggered offsets, each with a small save-count chip, the middle column shifted down 60px.

images.rationale: Pinterest feed demo is photo-shaped, so 3 portrait pins (statue, windowsill, café crumbs) are shared between the landing hero masonry collage and the demo grid; 1 testimonial headshot for Gary. No separate 16:9 hero: the hero composition is a pin collage, so the pins carry it. Remaining demo pins and the other two testimonials fall back to CSS/SVG treatments.
